label: VERIFIED
extraction: OpenCode Agent Skills: reusable instructions loaded on-demand via native skill tool. Skills discovered from 6 locations: .opencode/skills/, ~/.config/opencode/skills/, .claude/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, .agents/skills/, ~/.agents/skills/. Project-local paths walk up to git worktree. Global from home config dirs. Skill name rules: 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumeric with single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens, no consecutive hyphens. Regex: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$. Must match directory name containing SKILL.md. SKILL.md requires YAML frontmatter with name (matches folder), description, optional license, compatibility, metadata.
